about: A sign-in service you run yourself, giving many apps one shared login page and user list.

prs.title: The service starts again with one common database setting
prs.broken: The settings let you name the small file-based database as "sqlite3". With that name the service crashed on startup, because one part still did not know it.
prs.changed: That part now treats "sqlite3" as the same database, the way the rest of the service already did.
prs.matters: People using that setting can start the service and sign in again.

prs.title: Signing out reaches every connected app again
prs.broken: When someone signs out, the service tells connected apps to sign them out too. For some security settings that message was never sent, or apps rejected it.
prs.changed: The sign-out message is now locked with the same method and key as the app's sign-in pass.
prs.matters: Signing out in one place signs you out of the connected apps, whichever security setting they use.
